blocks.text: It is safe to say that Against The Current is entering a defining new era. To celebrate their 15th anniversary as a band, the powerhouse pop-rock trio has unleashed “Dead Man Walking”—a track that serves as a massive milestone in their ongoing musical evolution. Released under their independent banner and distributed via Stem, this brand-new single hits with an unapologetic intensity. It serves as definitive proof that this band is no longer just swimming upstream.
